sourceTitle: Aratra Pentelici, Seven Lectures on the Elements of Sculpture Given before the University of Oxford in Michaelmas Term, 1870
description: "Aratra Pentelici: Seven Lectures on the Elements of Sculpture" by John Ruskin is a collection of academic lectures written in the late 19th century. The book delves into the foundational principles of sculpture, aiming to reawaken interest in the art form and establish a framework for understanding its significance and methodology.
